lyrics: vara veeNa mrudhu pANi vanaruhalochana rANi - suruchira bambhara vENi suranutha kalyANi
nirupama shubha guNa lOla nirathishaya pradha sheela - varadhApriya ranganAyaki
vAnchitha phala dhAyaki - sarasijAsana janani jaya jaya jaya

text: You hold the divine veena in your soft hands. You are the queen of the omniscient. Your eyes are like lotus petals. Your curly tresses resemble bees. The Devas worship your auspicious form. You have unequaled virtuous qualities. You give endless victory. You are Ranganaayaki, the consort of Ranganatha. You grant the boons desired by your devotees. O Mother of Brahma, who is seated on a lotus! Victory to you.

lyric: varaveeNA mRdu pAni vanaruha lOchana raaNi
nirupama Subha guNa lOla niratajaya prada Seela
saraseejasana jananI jaya jaya jaya jaya vANI
text: You hold the divine (“vara”) veena in your soft (“mrudu”) hands (“paani”). You are the queen (“raani”) of the omniscient. Your eyes (“lochana”) are like lotus petals (“vanaruha”). Your curly (“suruchira”) tresses (“veni”) resemble bees (“bambhara”). The Devas (“Sura”) worship (“nuta”) your auspicious form (“kalyaani”). You have (“lola”) unequaled (“nir-upama”) virtuous (“shuba”) qualities (“guna”). You (“sheela”) give (“prada”) endless (“narathi”) victory (“jaya”). You are Ranganaayaki, the consort (“priya”) of Ranganatha (“varadaa”). You grant (“daayaki”) the boons (“phala”) desired (“vaanchita”) by your devotees. O Mother (“janani”) of Brahma, who is seated on a lotus (“saraseeja-asana”)! Victory (“jaya”) to you.
